nodes.label: ASAM Level 1 — Outpatient
nodes.summary: Outpatient psychiatric services for stable patients who do not require 24-hour monitoring — insufficient for Jordan M. Ellis at admission.

nodes.label: ASAM Level 2 — Intensive Outpatient
nodes.summary: IOP/PHP-level services (typically 9–20 hrs/week). Patient acuity exceeded this due to active suicidal plan and command hallucinations.

nodes.label: ASAM Level 3 — Residential
nodes.summary: Residential treatment with structured milieu but without 24/7 physician-directed care — ruled out given psychosis and 1:1 observation need.

nodes.label: ASAM Level 4 — Medically Managed Intensive Inpatient
nodes.summary: 24/7 physician-directed acute inpatient psychiatry — the justified level for Jordan M. Ellis days 1–8 per ASAM Dimension 3 acuity.

nodes.label: LOCUS Level 0 — Recovery Maintenance

nodes.label: LOCUS Level 1 — Low Intensity Community

nodes.label: LOCUS Level 2 — Outpatient

nodes.label: LOCUS Level 3 — Intensive Outpatient
